name: manymotions-travel-video
description: Turn a destination into a travel guide, journey diary or short documentary video, narrated over generated scenes of the place, produced in your ManyMotions account.

interface.longDescription:
Turn a destination or a journey into a narrated travel video: a travel guide, a first-person journey diary or a short documentary.

Describe the place, the angle, the highlights to include and who the video is for, plus the spoken language, format and length. The plugin prepares a brief and shows the number of scenes and the credits it will use. When you confirm, ManyMotions writes the script scene by scene, generates the keyframes and the scene videos of the place with AI narration, and edits the final cut. A video takes several minutes; ChatGPT reports the progress and returns the link to the MP4.

For travel creators, tour operators, teachers and anyone planning or sharing a trip.

Limitations: scenes are generated, not filmed, so they are illustrative and not footage of the real place; check facts such as opening hours and travel rules yourself. It does not edit uploaded travel footage or use photos of real people. Producing a video uses your signed-in ManyMotions account; preparing a brief does not need an account. If you are not signed in, the plugin gives a link where the same brief opens on ManyMotions.

ManyMotions is the platform formerly known as ClipWave.
capabilities: Track progress and return the MP4
defaultPrompt: A 30-second travel guide to Kyoto in autumn for first-time visitors
A journey diary of a road trip through Patagonia, 45 seconds, 16:9
A short documentary on the history of the Lisbon trams, narrated in Portuguese

positive.prompt: Make a 30-second travel guide to Kyoto in autumn for first-time visitors: temples, maple leaves and one food tip.
positive.expected_behavior: A brief with angle travel-guide, 30 seconds, 5 scenes and the credits it will use. Nothing is generated and no credits are spent.

positive.prompt: A journey diary of a road trip through Patagonia for YouTube, 16:9, 45 seconds.
positive.expected_behavior: A brief with angle journey-diary, format 16:9 and length 45 seconds (7 scenes), and the credits required. Nothing is generated.

positive.description: Produce a video and return it
positive.prompt: An 8-second travel guide teaser for the Amalfi Coast at sunset. Yes, generate it now and send me the video link when it is ready.
positive.expected_behavior: The brief is prepared (2 scenes, 500 credits). After the go-ahead (if ChatGPT asks to confirm first, reply "Generate it"), generate_video starts the production in the signed-in account (state processing, credits used shown). get_video reports the current step; asked again once the production has completed (usually 5 to 10 minutes), it returns the absolute MP4 link and the ManyMotions link to open it.

positive.description: Short guide for a specific audience
positive.prompt: A 15-second travel guide to Marrakech for budget backpackers, with the souks and one food tip, 4:5.
positive.expected_behavior: A brief with angle travel-guide, format 4:5, length 15 seconds (3 scenes) and the credits required. Nothing is generated.

positive.prompt: A short documentary on the history of the Lisbon trams for history lovers, narrated in Portuguese.
positive.expected_behavior: A brief with angle documentary, language Portuguese and the credits required. Nothing is generated.

negative.prompt: Here are the clips from my trip to Bali, edit them into a vlog with music.
Book me a hotel in Kyoto for next weekend under 150 dollars a night.
What documents do I need to travel from Italy to Japan?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Producing a video uses credits of the user's existing ManyMotions account; no purchase happens in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Resubmission with no functional changes: prepare a brief, produce the video in the linked ManyMotions account and follow it to the MP4.
